# ActiveWorkspace RandomEncounters — Covenant Engine & Timezone Revision 2

This is a full merge overlay, not a delta patch. Extract it at the ActiveWorkspace repository root so `assets/RandomEncounters`, `assets/tokens`, and `assets/grids` merge into the existing project.

## Current authoritative rules

The add-on now uses `assets/RandomEncounters/json/universal_how_to_play.json` as its mechanical authority: **D&D 5.5e: Universal Edition — Covenant Engine**.

- Encounters use **Threat Points**, not adjusted XP, for generation and calibration. Adjusted XP remains in exported records only as a legacy compatibility display.
- Conflict uses **alternating-side initiative**, **3 Beats per turn**, and **1 Reaction**.
- A converted creature Multiattack is one **2-Beat Strike**.
- Bosses receive extra initiative slots and telegraphed reactions instead of unrestricted legendary-action spam.
- Every generated encounter has a non-HP objective, Progress and Danger clocks, multiple valid approaches, and an explicit player-autonomy rule.
- The existing eight-axis alignment, 81 profiles, 22 deity covenants, 22 merged deity-bound classes, 66 subclasses, and 236 race entries remain active.

## World UTC, local time, and encounter schedules

Universal retains Earth UTC as its universal zero reference. It never uses daylight saving time.

Timezone resolution is:

1. settlement fixed UTC offset;
2. province fixed UTC offset;
3. explicit encounter offset;
4. fixed offset derived from longitude at one hour per 15°;
5. UTC.

A settlement can therefore use a different timezone from its province and from nearby settlements. The exported encounter stores both world UTC and encounter-local time, including the source of the offset, named meridian/parallel proximity, local daypart, schedule state, and any nearby timezone crossing.

Local time affects encounter weighting and presentation: public activity, commerce, patrol changes, witnesses, opening and closing routines, services, travel traffic, night watch, covert activity, nightlife, and nocturnal threats.

## Calendar

- 11 months per civil year
- 30 days per month
- 330 counted civil days in a common year
- one intercalary leap day every seventh year, after Month 11
- 330.15 astronomical Universal days equal 365.2422 Earth days
- no twelfth month and no month longer than 30 days

## ActiveWorkspace integration

The add-on reads optional hooks or events for:

- party state;
- semantic location, province, settlement, longitude, latitude, and fixed UTC offsets;
- shared Universal world UTC date and time;
- damage application and combat progression.

The generator UI also provides manual location, timezone, calendar, objective, terrain, support, and preparation controls when ActiveWorkspace or WorldBuilder does not supply them.

## Deployment

- Keep ActiveWorkspace’s existing HTML; this package intentionally contains no HTML entry point.
- Load the stylesheet and JavaScript files in the exact order listed by `assets/RandomEncounters/json/module_manifest.json`.
- `universal-time.js` must load before `data-loader.js` and `encounter-generator.js`.
- Keep all runtime JSON beside the module. The embedded fallback contains the same current Covenant Engine, time, calendar, alignment, class, race, pantheon, and encounter-table data.
- `docs/canonical_sources/latest_json` contains the authoritative converted source set used for this revision. Older D&D-only play/spell snapshots were moved to `docs/canonical_sources/archived_previous_revision`.

## Verification

The final build validates JavaScript and JSON, source archives, image assets, manifest references, canon counts and relationships, fixed-offset precedence, minute and fractional-hour offsets, all seven dayparts, date rollover, the seventh-year intercalary day, live and offline generation, Threat Point limits, objectives and clocks, alternating initiative, three-Beat hostile turns, boss slots, and timezone-aware dialogue context.

See `REVISION_2_AUDIT.md`, `BUILD_AUDIT.json`, and `test_results.json`.
